title: sister_wedding_seat
beats: I skipped my sister's wedding rehearsal dinner and told everyone I had food poisoning.
I was sitting in my car outside the venue for two hours, because I found out that morning her fiance was the guy I matched with on a dating app three weeks earlier.
We never met up. It was just messages. But he asked me not to tell anyone we'd talked, and I agreed, because I didn't think it would go anywhere.
Then I saw his face on the seating chart as "groom" and my stomach dropped through the floor.
I sat there rehearsing what I'd say to my sister, and every version ended with her wedding falling apart three days before the ceremony.
So I said nothing. I texted him one line: "delete the conversation, I already have."
He wrote back "thank you" and that was it. Forever.
I watched my sister marry him two days later from the second row, smiling in every photo.
That was fourteen months ago. She's due with their first baby next week, and I still haven't told a single person why I really missed that dinner.
